recommendations.name: Macel Fernandez-Estavillo
recommendations.relationship: Parent of an IB Biology SL student
recommendations.quote: Amanda has been teaching my daughter Biology SL via zoom (she is in Canada and we are in the Philippines) since the start of IB and has helped her get to a 7. She is very supportive and encouraging, while staying persistent in making sure her students understand the topics. She's the perfect mix of solid academic tutoring and a kind, supportive personality.
recommendations.short_quote: She's the perfect mix of solid academic tutoring and a kind, supportive personality.

recommendations.name: Lynne Gadkowski
recommendations.relationship: Parent of an IB ESS student
recommendations.quote: Amanda has a real gift for breaking down difficult themes and showing how each one fits into the big picture of the course. She also nurtured the confidence in my IB student in this complicated course, and the confidence spilled over into other courses as well.
recommendations.short_quote: Amanda has a real gift for breaking down difficult themes and showing how each one fits into the big picture of the course.

recommendations.name: Yasir Dawood
recommendations.relationship: Parent of an IB Biology student
recommendations.quote: Amanda has been an excellent IB Biology tutor for my daughter. She explains complex topics clearly, aligns lessons with the IB syllabus, and gives practical exam strategies and IA feedback. My daughter’s confidence and grades have improved noticeably, I highly recommend Amanda to any IB student looking for a knowledgeable and supportive Biology tutor.

recommendations.name: Olufemi Banjo
recommendations.relationship: Parent of an IB Diploma Biology student
recommendations.quote: Amanda built a strong relationship with our son based on trust and encouragement. She focused not just on academic content, but also on helping him apply what he learned and communicate it clearly, which made a noticeable difference throughout his course. She also helped him grow in confidence, stay motivated, and see challenges as part of the learning process.

recommendations.name: Vy Nguyen
recommendations.quote: She had a gift for making complex ideas simple and always treated her students with trust and respect. Her belief in me pushed me to take ownership of my growth, and her guidance was key in helping me navigate university applications. Even now, her advice continues to shape who I am.
recommendations.short_quote: She had a gift for making complex ideas simple and always treated her students with trust and respect.

recommendations.name: Anna Nguyen
recommendations.quote: Even though I wasn't great at Biology in High School, she never lost faith in my potential. Her empathetic and supportive approach made me believe in myself. Her classroom was a welcoming, inclusive space where questions were encouraged, and every student felt valued.

recommendations.name: Ozma Bashir
recommendations.relationship: Former colleague on the AKIS science team
recommendations.quote: I had the distinct pleasure of working alongside Amanda at AKIS, where she was an integral part of the science team and an exceptional teacher. Amanda’s dedication to delivering engaging and diverse lessons set a high standard for educational excellence within our institution.

recommendations.name: Kimberly Croft
recommendations.relationship: Former colleague and educational technology coach
recommendations.quote: Amanda is an outstanding Biology and Chemistry teacher. Having had the pleasure of working closely with her as an EdTech coach in an international school, I can attest to her unwavering dedication to her students' growth, encouraging students to think critically and independently. Amanda's warm and collaborative approach, combined with her innovative use of technology, creates a highly enriching learning environment. Her commitment to ongoing development reflects her passion for teaching and ensuring each student's success. Above all, Amanda always puts her students’ learning and wellbeing first. Without a doubt, Amanda would be a valuable asset to any team.

recommendations.name: Dave Crowden PhD
recommendations.quote: Amanda is a dynamo. She needs only to be unleashed. Amanda’s intensity is worth at least three staff especially in areas of administration, facilitation, event organising and supervision of student led tasks. During my time working with Amanda, she supervised a group of students who transformed the school for events like Halloween, Prom and Tet (lunar new year). Amanda’s record keeping was immaculate and her planning was submitted for WASC accreditation. Treat her well, and delegate tasks that need someone with extremely high capabilities and energy and she will become Wonder Woman at school. Students and colleagues love her!
